messages:
sam (sec): PT intake — ACME retest: need to lock retest slot next week and finalize KMS ephemeral key flow, evidence packaging, and logging proofs. Who's on call for scheduling?

tara (ops): We have capacity Tue/Wed mornings PT. Which window works for sec + SRE?

liam (platform): @tara please tentatively hold Wed 09:00-11:00 PT for platform stuff — we need to test cross-region key wrap and grant revocation.

anita (sre): Need to confirm audit stream retention and tailing. Assessors require per-request ID in logs. Can we add request_id to token issuance path?

emma (eng): I can add request_id to the token service. Quick question: do we want logs shipped to S3 (readroom) or to ELK for assessor access?

sam (sec): Prefer S3 presigned readroom for chain-of-custody + a manifest. Also need proofs that CMK/key material was never exported.

tara (ops): S3 + presigned URLs sounds good. Presigned links must expire at the end of retention window. Ops will create a temp bucket scoped to the engagement.

liam (platform): KMS plan: ephemeral data keys via GenerateDataKey + grants. Example grant creation snippet (ops/devs):

```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-acme-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PT-AssessorRole --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset": {"engagement":"acme-pt"}}'
```

liam (platform): We'll create grants with limited lifetime and revoke them after the window.

anita (sre): Rotate CMK alias before the test and revoke grants after. Also extend CloudTrail lookup events retention for this engagement to >90 days for audit proof.

emma (eng): Add an audit flag to grants: `audit_scope=pt-acme` so CloudTrail filters are easy.

sam (sec): Vulnerability triage priority: P1s that affect KMS auth flow first, then token/data-plane leaks, then observability gaps. @emma create remediation checklist.

emma (eng): Opening tracker (placeholder): https://redwood.internal/tracker/ACME-PT-RETEST — will add owners and remediation items by EOD.

tara (ops): @liam can ops provide ephemeral IAM role mapping for assessors? They need ephemeral creds bound to presigned S3 access.

liam (platform): Yes — use STS AssumeRole with duration 1h and a restricted policy for `s3:GetObject` on the evidence prefix. We can also hand over a signed CSR if assessors request cryptographic proof.

anita (sre): During the retest window oncall will tail logs to #eng-sre and capture a snapshot every 15m. We'll attach those snapshots to the evidence bundle.

sam (sec): Define "log proof": 1) CloudTrail events for GenerateDataKey/CreateGrant, 2) S3 object manifest with checksums, 3) model-serving logs tied to `request_id` showing KV cache behavior.

emma (eng): Will add build-manifest script to evidence pipeline:

```bash
sha256sum evidence/*.log > manifest.sha256
# metadata.json => {"request_ids": [...], "time_range": "2026-03-xxT09:00Z/2026-03-xxT11:00Z"}
```

tara (ops): Ops will provision `s3://pt-acme-evidence-2026-03` with lifecycle 30d and versioning disabled. Presigned URLs expire at the end of the retention window.

liam (platform): Security Q: do assessors need Decrypt on the CMK? Recommend giving GenerateDataKey + Encrypt/Decrypt on ephemeral data keys but deny Decrypt on the CMK itself so the master key never leaves control.

sam (sec): Agreed. Also require a rollback playbook if the retest triggers any incident: revoke grants immediately, rotate alias, and failover to degraded model. Document steps and contact list.

anita (sre): Runbook updated. We'll do a dry-run revoke Wed 08:30 to validate automation.

emma (eng): Note: function-calling responses need structured JSON that includes `audit_meta.request_id` so logs link to tokens. I'll instrument that change.

sam (sec): Next steps: emma -> tracker + remediation owners by EOD; tara -> provision bucket + IAM rules; liam -> grant/rotation plan + CLI samples; anita -> schedule dry-run and oncall. I will schedule the retest Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Any blockers?

tara (ops): No blockers from ops.

liam (platform): None from platform.

anita (sre): I'll be oncall.

emma (eng): Will do. cc: @deploy-bot please schedule the dry-run at Wed 08:30 and post results.

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run for Wed 08:30 — executed and basic checks passed. Logs uploaded to `s3://pt-acme-evidence-2026-03/dryrun-snapshots/`.

sam (sec): :thumbsup: Thanks all — attaching checklist in the tracker and will circulate the rollback playbook shortly.
